title: 1 year of Claude Code and here’s how my .claude folder runs the show
description:
1 year of Claude Code and here’s how my .claude folder runs the show.

agents — 6 specialists, each trained on one job
slash commands — shortcuts I type once and reuse forever
hooks — rules Claude must follow, no exceptions
rules — split into frontend.md, database.md, never one giant mess
skills — auto-applied when Claude spots the situation
CLAUDE.md — the brain of the whole project 🔥

Comment “CLAUDE” and the full setup lands in your DMs.
